reply_text:
I replied to Dana in her DM. Her cutoff for the Brackenwater Freight Co. paperwork on the Juniper renewal is 26 September.

That date comes from her own DM with me on 14 October, when she asked me to remember it. The knowledge brain keeps it as a note only she can see. She didn't give a year, and 26 September had already passed by 17 October, so I asked her to tell me if she meant a different date.

One thing I didn't raise with her: a public North pipeline note from September 2025 says Brackenwater was moving to Marcus Lindqvist on 15 September 2025. That may be out of date, so I didn't question her date.
